chapter: Entertainers, Creole Serenaders and La Vida
title: The Davis brothers who played at La Vida
summary: Turner clarifies which Davis played drums at La Vida and how he relates to Jimmy Davis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, this Davis, you said his brother was a piano player? Before you were telling us about it.
Yeah, Jimmy. Jimmy Davis. That was Jimmy Davis' brother playing the drum at the computer with the power of this.
Was he akin to Robert Davis? I think that's his name.
Robert Davis was a drummer, yeah. Okay, before we leave La Vida, let's check it again, huh?
